name: Cana
overview: Cana of Galilee is notably the setting of Jesus' first recorded miracle, where He attended a marriage feast with His mother and disciples. When the wine ran out, Jesus initially expressed that His time had not yet come, yet He ultimately performed the miracle by turning water into wine, demonstrating His divine authority and compassion. This event, marked by the presence of traditional Jewish purification vessels, highlights the significance of obedience to Jesus' commands, as His mother instructed the servants to do whatever He said.
